hooks.name: Project graph: sync before replying
hooks.description: Each turn, record on the project graph any state change of the work (results, merges, decisions, findings) before replying.

action.prompt: Project graph sync check: before ending this turn, if a workflow result, merge, user decision or finding in this turn changed the state of work, record it on docs/graph through the graph engine (status with evidence, comment, or decide with the user's words as relay), render and commit. Do not report progress that is not on the graph.
